title: LIMENORA Injection Rule
description: Secret or credential injection rule applied to an intercepted request. Shared between the Go and Rust gateways.

name.description: Header name, query parameter name, or body key.

value.description: Literal value; omitted when a credential binding ref is used.

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token material when present.

credential_binding_ref.description: Reference to a boundary-resolved credential; rules carrying this ref are stripped of secret material.
